title: Whoever It Is, Whatever It Is
goal: Review the repeated subjunctive and add sea quien sea and sea cual sea.
grammar: Repeated subjunctive with ser: sea quien sea, sea cual sea

items: I can say sea quien sea, sea cual sea and sea lo que sea for whoever and whatever it is.
I can repeat a subjunctive verb around a relative word to say it makes no difference.
I can use the new words for opinions.
